decided: When the AI runs a command the user has allowed it to run unasked, it treats each question by its kind: a question about which change or which review to work on is not asked, since the next command already names it; a routine question, one that already marks a default and sends nothing outside the project, takes that default and records that it did; every other question stops the run. Leftover review notes or unfinished tasks at archive also stop the run, once a later change of this stage lets the AI reach archive unasked.
alternatives: stop the run at every question, routine ones included
answer every question that marks a default, leftover notes and unfinished tasks included
why: Stopping at every question means a run can never get through archive, which always asks before updating the specs; answering questions about unfinished work would let a run go past exactly what a stop is meant to catch.
